verdict.rationale: n8n's GitHub README says you can combine visual building with JavaScript, Python, and npm packages, and the homepage promises you can "go deep with code". A hands-on community user independently confirms custom code blocks in JS and Python as workflow steps. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Code node itself (runtime, data access, sandbox limits), and clarity on library and npm imports, which a community user describes as limited.
